name: legal-subscription-agreement
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint) securities subscription-agreement document template for accredited-investor and Family & Friends offerings. One recipe covers both structural variants — they differ only in which schedule variants and per-schedule named page counters are present, not in base geometry or type.

variants.name: cover-key-terms
variants.description: H1 + subtitle, key-terms table, completion checklist, 'not a prospectus' warning box (rule.emphasis border).

variants.name: subscriber-execution
variants.description: Tier-2 accessible fill-section: fill-label/fill-line/fill-hint pairs in fill-cols layout, sans-fill font for legibility.

variants.name: corporate-acceptance
variants.description: Full-width fill-label-sm -> fill-line -> signature-attribution block (not fill-cols).

variants.name: schedule-a-usa-joinder
variants.description: US-accredited-investor joinder schedule — DATED-AT hand-blank spans, party execution.

variants.name: schedule-b-category
variants.description: Accredited-investor category schedule — category letter / description / initials-box table.

variants.name: prescribed-form-writein
variants.description: Consolidated NI 45-106-family prescribed-form write-in cells (f9-writein 0.5in, f9-sign 0.62in, f9-writein-lg 0.92in, initials-head) — the cell border doubles as the write line.

aria: Fill-in form fields use real <label>/<input> or contenteditable-safe markup with associated labels, not placeholder-only text — the tier-2 sans-fill register exists specifically for completion accessibility. Schedule tables use <table> with <th scope="col">.

wcag.note: Fill zones are the accessibility surface — larger sans-serif type (10pt Verdana/Tahoma stack) versus the 9.5pt serif body.

motion: Print-first static document — no interaction states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint.
open_questions: oq-1: F9/F12 prescribed-form cell height-as-minimum only holds in WeasyPrint's table model — would need re-verification if a browser-print distribution path is ever added.

oq-2: em-dash convention — this family mandates a literal UTF-8 em-dash (warns \2014 eats the trailing space in WeasyPrint); reconcile against agency-suite which uses \2014 before any shared draft-stamp recipe is built.
oq-3: distribution shape (inline vs. externally-linked CSS) differs from the prospectus family's own convention — not yet normalized across Paper.
